name: Tarun ID-JAG Runner
description: Runs the PingFederate ID-JAG (cross-app access) demo without Postman: password grant + refresh, RFC 8693 exchange for the ID-JAG assertion (three subject variants), jwt-bearer redeem + introspection at the resource AS, four refusal cases, and a JWKS inspector. Real PingFederate 13.1+ only; client secrets are typed per session and write-only.
notes: Real PingFederate only (owner exception, 2026-11-06): the idjag-* demo objects must exist on the target PF; set the runtime URL in Settings. Docker: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:4780 only; HOST_PORT moves it).
